title: Record one n=8 parity prefix at 3/2 (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

For the one `n = 8` symbol `(1, 1/2, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0)`, every proper prefix of the nested parity-split schedule has infinity norm exactly `3/2`. This is the first step left open by #4699. The branch is from fetched main and does not replay that unmerged package.

The tail `l1` is `1/2`. The schedule applies the right shear, then the even child, then the Schur child, then the left shear, and repeats that order inside every child. There are 22 factors in the top even/odd basis. Five differ from `I`. The last of those five is the top left shear, so four nontrivial factors sit in the proper prefixes. All 21 proper prefixes have infinity norm `3/2`. The product of the 22 factors equals the even/odd reordering of the Toeplitz matrix.

The product of two one-level caps is `9/4`, and the product of four caps is `81/16`. Both are larger than the recorded prefix. On this symbol, nesting does not lift a proper prefix above the one-level cap. The Schur child is `(1, -1/4, 0, 0)`, and its Schur child is `(1, -1/16)`.

This is one symbol. It does not bound every tail of `l1` at most `1/2`, the generator-shear compiler, the completed Gaussian stage, or the dyadic `p^100` normalizer. No new κ. The selected record is `60403/20000000`.

## Test plan

- [x] `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/triangular-parity-n8`
- [x] Prints `PASS_TRIANGULAR_PARITY_N8` and `outcome=completed`
- [ ] Maintainer replay was not run

Base `b58ad9ef4d4e861b0eaa5dba41742bdc072dca51`, priority revision 7. Upstream fetches at 2026-10-22T16:35:02Z, 2026-10-22T16:42:39Z, and the pre-submit fetch at 2026-10-22T16:42:54Z were that commit. The pinned blobs of `certificates/selected-result.json` (`c35482cd9035843b15a634cc8276a7e1e40e8395`), `GAUSSIAN.md` (`adfb28c93e6b06178c901caaac39ede41a9e541b`), and `vendor/SHALLOW-TOEPLITZ.md` (`bc4349b2daea548ffa09e1f38a31f1df86b0b7be`) were unchanged. κ remains `60403/20000000`.
